rows.text: takes entry `edx` (sign-extended) of the qword array at qword `rcx+0x60` (a null `rcx` makes the following `+8` read start from address 0); when the low byte of the entry's dword `+8` `AND 0x3C` equals 4 it returns entry `r8d` (sign-extended) of the qword array at qword `+0x60` of the entry's qword `+0x18`, or 0 when that `+0x18` qword is null; otherwise it returns the entry itself

notes: 003931E0: the mismatch path returns rax, which still holds the first-level entry pointer, not 0.
